title: Nonpositive within-fibre dyadic Mobius correlation
statement: At the two binary Lemire endpoints, for every valid interval degree d, the sum of squared signed Mobius correlations over the exact input-coset, shift, and inverse-difference fibres is at most the total population of those fibres.

provenance.source: Axeyum gf2-lemire lane; exact dyadic fibre L2 and nilpotent parallelogram decomposition

notes: This is the open counting half E2', not a promoted finite pattern. By the proved inverse-difference identity, subtracting the fibre populations leaves exactly the restricted four-shift sum over h*t*(t+h)=0 with t nonzero. The candidate holds in exhaustive endpoint rows through ell=7, the pinned (ell,k,d)=(9,11,8) row with defect -9368, and maximal-interval fleet rows through ell=14. These observations are controls only. Even a universal proof would validate a local inverse-energy input but would not control the complementary signed cross-order Mobius convolution or prove Lemire.
